flawed_step: Step 2 (reverse inclusion): From x ∈ cl(A) ∩ cl(B), one cannot infer x ∈ cl(A ∩ B). Although every neighborhood of x intersects A and intersects B, those intersections may occur at different points, so the neighborhood need not intersect A ∩ B.
assessment_summary: The forward inclusion cl(A ∩ B) ⊆ cl(A) ∩ cl(B) is justified by monotonicity of closure. The attempted reverse inclusion fails at Step 2, so the claimed equality is not valid for arbitrary subsets.
